We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 
 Why this role is on the menu
 Instacart's Commercial business is building the path for advertisers and retailers to grow, and the Ads ecosystem needs a Product Marketing center of excellence to lead it. This role leads a team of advertising-focused Product Marketers with cohesive go-to-market strategies and inbound and outbound marketing plans, so product and feature launches land seamlessly. Without it, positioning, messaging, and the voice of the advertiser have no single owner to inform Product and the Ads roadmap. Twelve months from now, Instacart Ads has a consistent, best-in-market narrative and a scaled PMM function that is indispensable to the GTM motion.
 What you'll cook up in your first year
 A center of excellence for Ads product marketing: a team of skilled product marketers running comprehensive, consistent launch motions that follow best practices and scale PMM impact
 An Ads ecosystem narrative, messaging, and outbound marketing strategy that reinforces market leadership across all marketing touchpoints, with consistent branding, messaging, and positioning across all channels
 Priority Ads features and new product opportunities shaped by the voice of the customer, blending quantitative and qualitative insights from advertisers and the market, and influencing the product roadmap and business strategy
 Strategic, high visibility launches and marketing programs executed and measured against product-specific business goals, building the sales pipeline and driving product adoption through thought leadership, industry briefings, and events
 A sales team and advertiser base educated on the value of Instacart's data and measurement products, in partnership with Sales Enablement, with a clear investment strategy across paid marketing, trade partnerships, events, communications, creative, and content set with Growth Marketing
 The secret ingredients we're looking for
 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 
 12+ years of experience in product marketing and related product/marketing roles with at least 6 years in digital advertising and tech industry specifically 
 Experience in both outbound and inbound Product Marketing efforts 
 Team management experience, across multiple product lines 
 Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related field 
 Digital advertising experience and deep understanding of the digital ecosystem and advertising technologies 
 Proven track record of developing and executing successful go-to-market strategies 
 Experience in defining product marketing objectives and key results (OKRs) and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) 
 Executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to articulate marketing concepts to a broad set of audiences 
 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 
 Retail Media Network, CPG and/or Retailer experience 
 Experience using AI to find efficiencies in workflow/processes 
 A passion for media, measurement and the advertising industry

 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here .

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.
 La différence que vous ferez : 
 On est à la recherche d'une personne talentueuse et expérimentée qui s'occupera de diverses préoccupations liées à la sécurité pour notre communauté, y compris les suivantes, mais sans s'y limiter : la discrimination, les menaces à la sécurité personnelle, la violence conjugale, le suicide ou l'automutilation, l'exploitation d'enfants, les agressions physiques et sexuelles, les activités liées à la drogue, le travail sexuel et la traite de personnes. 
 Le ou la candidat·e retenu·e comprendra très bien comment identifier correctement des situations menaçantes et préjudiciables, communiquera avec empathie, fera preuve de discernement, prendra des décisions rapidement, aura comme objectif d'offrir le meilleur soutien possible aux personnes survivantes et permettra leur rétablissement. 
 Il s'agit d'un poste à temps plein situé ici : Canada. Ce poste est un rôle de première ligne dans un centre d'appels où il y a des interactions directes avec les clients. Les candidats retenus ont besoin d'excellentes compétences en communication, d'une aptitude à la résolution de problèmes et d'une expertise en service à la clientèle. Ils doivent être en mesure de s'adapter et de réagir dans un environnement dynamique, parfois sous pression, tout en restant flexibles, proactifs, débrouillards, efficaces, très professionnels et respectueux de la confidentialité. 
 Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous devez être flexible et accepter de changer d'équipe au sein du soutien à la communauté, ou encore d'assumer des responsabilités différentes de celles énoncées ci-dessous. La personne idéale est ouverte à l'évolution de ses fonctions en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise et elle restera flexible pour répondre à ces besoins. 
 Une journée typique : 
 Les responsabilités énumérées ci-dessous ne sont pas exhaustives. Compte tenu de la nature dynamique de ce travail, les responsabilités énoncées ci-dessous peuvent changer et des tâches supplémentaires peuvent être attribuées au besoin.
 Gestion de dossiers complexes : vous avez « perfectionné l'essentiel » de votre rôle, qui consiste à fournir le plus haut niveau de service à notre communauté. 
 Interagir avec les clients d'Airbnb et les membres de la communauté en utilisant tous les canaux actuels et futurs, qu'il s'agisse des outils Airbnb ou d'outils externes, dont le clavardage, les réseaux sociaux, la messagerie et le téléphone.
 Gérer de bout en bout des dossiers complexes dans le but de régler les problèmes des clients en suivant la méthodologie de travail et les directives. 
 Reconnaître le type et la gravité des dossiers et bien les traiter en fonction du champ d'application du service et en faisant appel à d'autres équipes, le cas échéant.
 Prendre en charge des dossiers d'un certain degré de gravité ou de complexité sous étroite supervision.
 Être capable de reconnaître et d'évaluer les comportements menaçants et risqués.
 Faire preuve de responsabilité et de discernement, ainsi qu'avoir la capacité de remettre en question la méthodologie de travail et de s'en écarter au besoin (uniquement avec l'approbation de la direction).
 Faire montre d'une excellente ouverture aux commentaires de la direction, des équipes de qualité et du personnel clinique, et adopter rapidement des comportements pour améliorer la qualité de son travail. 
 Comprendre plusieurs points de vue sur un sujet ou une situation.
 Être en mesure d'évaluer et de présenter plusieurs options pour régler un problème.
 Être appelé·e, avec l'aide de la direction, à possiblement interagir avec les principales parties prenantes.
 Conjuguer efficacité et qualité : 
 A démontré sa capacité à gérer un plus grand nombre de dossiers sans nuire à la qualité de l'interaction et de la résolution.
 Participation à l'amélioration du service de sécurité : tirer parti de ses connaissances opérationnelles fonctionnelles pour soutenir la réussite de l'équipe. 
 Aider à documenter les méthodes de travail, les meilleures pratiques et les normes pour son ou ses services, comme demandé par la direction.
 Fournir une expertise et des conseils techniques ou fonctionnels aux membres moins expérimentés de l'équipe.
 Communication avec les parties prenantes : commencer à découvrir le réseau avec d'autres équipes de prestation et des partenaires fonctionnels clés. 
 Faire preuve d'ouverture et se montrer accessible lors de la résolution de problèmes.
 Comprendre les facteurs clés de son poste et comment ils sont interreliés.
 Votre expertise : 
 Parcours et expérience
 Avoir plus de trois ans d'expérience pertinente dans le service à la clientèle, la médiation, les services d'urgence, les opérations de Confiance et sécurité, ou encore avoir occupé des fonctions similaires dans un centre d'appels à passer des appels et à s'occuper des contacts clients.
 Avoir de l'expérience dans le domaine de l'hospitalité est un atout, en particulier le travail sur des plateformes technologiques.
 Être apte à travailler pendant la fin de semaine et les jours fériés, ainsi que tôt le matin et le soir. L'horaire peut changer pour répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise.
 Être apte à travailler dans un environnement sous haute pression en interagissant avec des images, des conversations et d'autres contenus sensibles, confidentiels et possiblement traumatisants.
 Compétences et expertise
 Avoir de l'entregent et de très bonnes compétences à communiquer à l'écrit comme à l'oral, y compris pour résoudre les conflits.
 Être capable d'organiser un volume de travail élevé, d'effectuer plusieurs tâches à la fois et d'établir les priorités tout en travaillant dans le respect des horaires, y compris les pauses, les pauses-repas et le temps de formation.
 Avoir des connaissances de base en informatique, y compris Apple/Mac OS et Google Suite.
 Maîtriser l'anglais. Connaître d'autres langues est un atout.
 Être en mesure de bien évaluer les risques, de comprendre le degré d'urgence, de faire preuve de discernement dans des situations risquées et de communiquer les informations les plus pertinentes aux parties prenantes.
 Être capable de s'adapter à de nouvelles tâches et responsabilités au besoin. 
 Faire montre d'une attitude proactive pour relever de nouveaux défis et s'adapter à l'évolution des priorités et des environnements. 
 Être apte à s'adapter à l'évolution des fonctions et des tâches avec ouverture et flexibilité, ainsi qu'à s'intégrer à une nouvelle équipe.
 Votre emplacement : 
 En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l’Ontario, le Québec, l’Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.
 Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance : 
 Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.
 Nous nous efforçons également de proposer un processus de candidature et d'entretien inclusif pour les personnes handicapées. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement. 
 Nous vous demandons de nous contacter uniquement si vous êtes un candidat dont le handicap vous empêche de remplir notre candidature en ligne.
 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
 Nous utilisons des outils automatisés pour aider notre équipe de recrutement à examiner efficacement un grand nombre de candidatures. Toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par une personne humaine. Ce rôle est nouvellement créé et ne remplace ni ne vient combler un poste existant. 
 How We'll Take Care of You: 
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 
 Canada Annual Pay Range
 $63,000 — $63,000 CAD 
 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 
 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Storage Engine team . This globally distributed, fully remote team of experienced engineers develops core storage and query technologies for observability workloads, including improving storage efficiency, advancing ES|QL query processing and performance, and optimizing data layouts for object storage.
 This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Elasticsearch's core storage and query engine. The ideal candidate has experience building high-performance, scalable database, search, or distributed systems, with a strong focus on storage, indexing, query execution, and performance optimization.
 Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable, intuitive and high-quality software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Lead the architectural evolution of core storage engine components, continuously identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in indexing layouts, serialization formats, and resource utilization.
 Lead cross organizational initiatives to drive and build industry-leading observability solutions.
 Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the logs and metrics capabilities of Elasticsearch.
 Drive continuous operational and system improvements by introducing best practices for clean coding standards, demystifying complex system behaviors, untangling complexity to bring architectural clarity across the platform.
 Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) across key areas of Elasticsearch, acting as a trusted technical advisor and mentor to the wider engineering organization.
 Work with a global community to triage, resolve, and review issues and pull requests, collaborating with domain experts as needed.
 Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!
 What You Bring
 You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
 You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
 You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
 You bring a prompt-engineering mindset to know how to leverage AI agents effectively, using sound engineering judgment to validate results and recognize its limitations.
 You have implemented novel techniques to efficiently index, store, and query time-series or logs data.
 You have experience with one or more data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Prometheus and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.
 You have strong core Java skills, a deep understanding of its concurrency primitives, with a proven ability to design and optimize efficient data structures and algorithms.
 You excel in a collaborative environment, actively participate in technical discussions, and work effectively across distributed teams. Because it's the best way we know how to build software.
 You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and collaborate with respect, empathy, and professionalism in a distributed team.
 Bonus Points
 You've built things with Elasticsearch before.
 You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.
 You’ve worked on data storage technology.
 You have experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.
 You have past working experience with database, search engine, OS, or cloud service development.
 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. 
 These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. 
 An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
 The typical starting salary range for this role is:
 $128,300 — $203,000 CAD 
 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
 Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
 Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
 Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
 Generous number of vacation days each year
 Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
 Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
 Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
 Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
 We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co . We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.
 Un employeur de choix 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive.  Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe?

 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien?

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 About Okta Secures AI Team 
 The Okta for AI Agents Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 
 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.
 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agentic Identity—including pioneer work with securing AI Agents and support for protocols like MCP. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.
 We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.
 About the role 
 In this role, you will join the Agent Access Policies sub-team under Okta Secures AI as a Principal Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to advance Okta's authorization capabilities. By replacing static, rule-based systems with dynamic AI security mechanisms, you will deliver real-time threat inspection, agent intent evaluation, and behavioral analysis—ensuring autonomous AI agents operate safely within specified bounds.
 Your core mission will be architecting and driving features for our unified control plane to establish the premier Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. In doing so, you will help execute our guiding principle: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."
 What you’ll be doing 
 Implement intent-based enforcement to verify agent runtime requests match their intended purpose, requiring key capabilities.
 Apply LLM reasoning and prompt parsing to interpret prompts, tool payloads, and intent in real time.
 Integrate low-latency inference or semantic evaluation engines directly into the API gateway request path.
 Use embeddings, vector search, or zero-shot classification to score alignment between agent intent and executed actions.
 Design confidence-scored decision engines that feed semantic verification results into policy frameworks (e.g., Cedar).
 Establish evaluation benchmarks, prompt injection defenses, and guardrails to prevent bypasses or false positives.
 Architect scalable ML and Generative AI systems integrating retrieval, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
 Optimize prompting, context retrieval, and RAG workflows for accuracy, safety, and efficiency in Claude-based systems.
 Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure model quality, correctness, groundedness, and safety in production.
 Implement schema validation, structured output enforcement, and guardrails to ensure reliable, compliant AI outputs.
 Mentor and coach engineers to support team and community growth.
 What you’ll bring to the role 
 10+ years of software development experience, with strong programming expertise in Python (and familiarity with Go or Typescript a plus).
 Hands-on experience with applied machine learning, from feature engineering to training and fine-tuning models.
 Hands-on experience with modern Generative AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
 Deep understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and knowledge-base workflows.
 Hands-on experience with LiteLLM, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, or other related AI agent frameworks.
 Familiarity with ML frameworks (FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark ML) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, etc.).
 Experience defining evaluation metrics, pipelines, and feedback loops for ML/GenAI systems.
 Proven ability to collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive greenfield initiatives forward, navigate unknowns, and iterate quickly and frequently.
 Experience building tools or infrastructure for AI/ML applications, with a deep understanding of the developer lifecycle in an AI-native world. 
 Extra credit 
 Experience integrating AI-driven systems with identity, authentication, or security products.
 Exposure to ethical AI, model risk, or compliance frameworks.
 Familiarity with evaluation datasets, synthetic data generation, or LLM-as-a-judge methods.
 Education:Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field

The Role
 This is a senior client-facing role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of strategy, growth, sales, and execution.
 You will work directly with founders and business owners, understand their business in depth, identify what is holding growth back, and help them decide what to do next.
 You are not here to simply manage a relationship.
 You are here to become a trusted partner in the growth of the business.
 That means understanding the client's goals, offer, market, acquisition strategy, sales process, delivery model, current constraints, and commercial priorities - then helping them turn that into a clear plan of action.
 In some conversations, you will be helping a founder sharpen their positioning.
 In others, you will be diagnosing why pipeline is weak, why sales are not converting, why execution is stalling, or where the next growth opportunity sits.
 Your job is to create clarity. To tell clients what matters now. To show them what needs to happen next. And to make sure the right actions actually happen.
 This is not a traditional Customer Success role.
 It is a role for someone who wants to become an exceptional commercial operator by working closely with ambitious founders and helping them solve real business problems.
 The Opportunity
 You will have exposure to a large number of businesses, markets, offers, sales models, and growth challenges.
 That creates an unusually steep learning curve.
 Instead of spending years inside one company solving one set of problems, you will see patterns across dozens of businesses and develop the judgment to quickly understand:
 What is actually holding growth back
 What is noise and what matters
 Where the highest-leverage opportunity is
 What the founder should focus on now
 What should be stopped
 What should be doubled down on
 How strategy should translate into execution
 Over time, the expectation is that clients see you as someone whose judgment they trust.
 Someone who can walk into a complicated situation, understand it quickly, simplify it, and give them a clear direction forward.
 If you want to build serious capability in growth strategy, founder communication, sales, operations, and commercial decision-making, this role gives you the environment to do it.
 What You Will Own
 Become a True Growth Partner to Clients
 You will work closely with founders to understand the business beyond surface-level account updates.
 You will build a clear picture of:
 Their business model
 Target market
 ICP
 Offer
 Pricing
 Positioning
 Acquisition channels
 Sales process
 Current pipeline
 Delivery model
 Team capacity
 Growth goals
 Immediate constraints
 From there, you will help determine the highest-priority actions required to move the business forward.
 Advise, Don't Just Support
 We are not looking for someone who simply responds to questions.
 We want someone capable of leading the thinking.
 You should be comfortable saying:
 "This is the problem I think we need to solve first."
 "This is where I think you're focusing on the wrong thing."
 "This is the strategy I would recommend."
 "This is what I would do over the next 30 days."
 "This is what needs to happen before we scale."
 You will challenge clients when needed, simplify decisions, and help them avoid wasting time on low-leverage work.
 Your value comes from your judgment, not just your responsiveness.
 Turn Strategy Into Action
 Good advice without execution is useless.
 Every strategic conversation should translate into clear priorities.
 You will help clients move from broad goals to focused execution:
 Define the objective
 Identify the constraint
 Decide the strategy
 Break it into clear actions
 Assign ownership
 Set timelines
 Review what happened
 Adjust based on results
 You should naturally reduce complexity rather than add to it.
 If a client has fifteen things they could be doing, your job is often to help them identify the two or three that actually matter.
 Help Clients Build Revenue
 You will think commercially.
 That means understanding the complete journey from market to revenue:
 Positioning → Acquisition → Conversations → Pipeline → Sales → Revenue → Delivery → Expansion
 You will help clients understand where that journey is breaking down.
 For example:
 If acquisition is weak, you investigate the offer, market, message, and channel.
 If leads are coming in but deals are not closing, you look at qualification, sales process, follow-up, positioning, and pricing.
 If sales are happening but delivery is becoming difficult, you help identify what needs to change operationally.
 You should be comfortable moving across the business rather than treating growth as a single function.
 Work Across Growth Channels
 Depending on the client, you may be advising across areas such as:
 Cold email
 Outbound
 Paid acquisition
 Offer development
 ICP and positioning
 Lead generation
 CRM and pipeline
 Sales process
 Follow-up
 Proposal strategy
 Pricing
 Go-to-market
 Operational priorities
 AI implementation and services
 You do not need to personally be the world's best practitioner in every function.
 You do need enough commercial understanding to identify what is working, what is not, ask the right questions, and make good strategic recommendations.
 Lead High-Level Client Conversations
 You will spend significant time speaking directly with founders and senior operators.
 These are not scripted check-ins.
 The conversations should be valuable enough that a founder would pay for the thinking itself.
 You will:
 Review business performance
 Analyse what has changed
 Identify opportunities
 Diagnose problems
 Challenge assumptions
 Set priorities
 Recommend strategy
 Help unblock decisions
 Create accountability
 Keep momentum high
 The standard is not whether the meeting happened.
 The standard is whether the meeting changed what happens next.
 Own the Bigger Picture
 Clients may have multiple people supporting different parts of their business.
 Your role is to maintain the full commercial picture.
 You should understand what everyone is working on, how it connects to the overall strategy, and whether the combined effort is actually moving the client toward their objective.
 If teams become disconnected, priorities conflict, or something important is falling through the cracks, you take ownership of resolving it.
 The client should feel like they have one clear strategic partner who understands the whole business.
 Identify Risk Before It Becomes a Problem
 Strong operators notice problems early.
 You should recognise when:
 A client is losing momentum
 Execution has stalled
 The strategy is not producing results
 Expectations have become misaligned
 Lead flow is weak
 Sales follow-up is poor
 Internal delivery is becoming a blocker
 The client is focusing on the wrong priorities
 Trust is beginning to decline
 Then act.
 Do not wait for a formal escalation.
 Part of being a trusted partner is being willing to address uncomfortable realities before they become larger problems.
 Skills & Competencies
 Commercial Judgment
 You understand how businesses grow and make money.
 You can connect strategy to revenue and distinguish between activity and actual commercial progress.
 Strong Diagnostic Ability
 You can listen to a complicated situation and quickly work out what the underlying issue is.
 You separate symptoms from root causes.
 Strategic Thinking
 You can move between the big picture and immediate execution.
 You know how to turn an ambitious goal into the next few actions that actually matter.
 Founder-Level Communication
 You can communicate confidently with intelligent, ambitious, demanding people.
 You are comfortable challenging ideas without becoming confrontational.
 You can give clear advice even when it is not what the client hoped to hear.
 High Ownership
 You do not wait to be told what to do when something is obviously not working.
 You investigate, decide what needs to happen, and move it forward.
 Structured Execution
 You are excellent at turning conversations into decisions, priorities, actions, owners, and timelines.
 Curiosity
 You genuinely enjoy understanding businesses.
 You want to know why an offer works.
 Why one market responds differently from another.
 Why one sales process converts and another does not.
 Why certain founders execute faster than others.
 That curiosity compounds into judgment.
 AI Fluency
 You actively use AI to improve your thinking and output.
 You should use AI to analyse businesses, prepare for conversations, research markets, structure plans, review performance, document decisions, and increase the quality and speed of your work.
 The Person We Want
 This role is best suited to someone who wants to accelerate their career by taking on real responsibility.
 You want to become the kind of person founders trust when making important decisions.
 You want to develop judgment, not just knowledge.
 You want to understand how businesses grow from the inside.
 You are excited by the idea of working across many different companies, seeing patterns quickly, and becoming better at solving commercial problems every week.
 You do not want to spend your career running scripted calls.
 You want to sit across from a founder, understand what they are trying to build, and help them build it.
 You Will Probably Not Fit If
 You want a traditional Customer Success role
 You prefer being given the answer rather than finding it
 You are uncomfortable advising people more senior than you
 You avoid giving direct recommendations
 You prefer following scripts to thinking independently
 You enjoy relationship management but are less interested in business strategy
 You are uncomfortable discussing revenue, sales, pricing, or performance
 You need very clear boundaries around your responsibilities
 You focus heavily on activity rather than outcomes
 You are looking for a low-pressure role with a predictable learning curve
 Experience
 7+ years in consulting, growth, client strategy, account management, sales, operations, or a senior client-facing role
 Experience working directly with founders, executives, or business owners
 Strong commercial understanding and the ability to think across acquisition, sales, and delivery
 Experience helping businesses solve growth or execution problems
 Strong understanding of B2B go-to-market
 Direct exposure to areas such as outbound, sales, offer creation, paid acquisition, pipeline management, consulting, or agency delivery
 Experience operating in fast-moving environments where judgment matters more than rigid process
 What You Get
 Fully remote
 Full-time role at a profitable, bootstrapped company
 Direct access to ambitious founders and business owners
 Exposure to a wide variety of companies, markets, and growth problems
 The opportunity to build deep skill across strategy, acquisition, sales, operations, and AI
 Significant autonomy and ownership
 Direct access to senior leadership
 A role where your judgment and capability can grow quickly
 Performance-based progression into leadership, strategy, operations, or broader commercial ownership
 Independent Contractor Agreement
 This is an opportunity to become much more than an account manager.
 Done well, this role develops you into the kind of commercial operator who can walk into almost any business, understand what matters, and help the founder decide what to do next.

 Partner with various business unit leaders to uncover operational friction points, identify high-impact AI use cases, and consolidate these into a unified AITO roadmap that drives operational change across the organization.

 Review and maintain Conditional Access, multifactor authentication, privileged access, role-based access control, and access-review configurations; validate changes against least-privilege principles and approved access requirements.

 Lead phishing simulation and security-awareness activities, including planning, execution, results analysis, targeted follow-up, and user guidance.

 Conditional Access, privileged access, RBAC, and access reviews completed on schedule, with findings documented.

 On-call security events triaged, documented, and escalated within established response targets.

 Experience operating or supporting a vulnerability-management program, including prioritization, remediation coordination, exception handling, and reporting.
 Experience supporting email security, identity controls, security awareness, third-party risk, policy implementation, or access reviews.
 Experience supporting significant incidents and working within formal escalation and on-call procedures.
 Skills & Qualifications
 Strong understanding of security operations, including alert triage, incident response, containment coordination, queue management, and investigation documentation.
 Working knowledge of Zscaler Internet Access, Zscaler Private Access, Client Connector, SASE, and Zero Trust concepts.
 Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft 365 security controls.

 Helping talented designers become even better. You’ll set the standard, give clear feedback, and make sure the work keeps improving.

Position Summary 
 We're looking for a Tax Manager to own tax for the companies Ventures builds. You'll set each new company up correctly from the start, keep it compliant as it grows, and build the process every future venture follows. The work centres on Canada and the U.S., with filings elsewhere coordinated through local advisors as ventures enter new markets. The role is based in Montreal.
 AI should be part of how you work. Use it to research, draft, analyze, and automate. You're responsible for the quality of the result.
 Values
 Sound judgment and attention to detail.
 Taking responsibility and finishing work without being chased.
 Understanding how a young company makes money and how tax follows it.
 Curiosity and a willingness to change an approach that isn't working.
 The honesty to say when a position isn't defensible, including your own.
 What you'll do
 Set up each new venture correctly 
 When Ventures decides to build a company, you'll work out what tax needs to be in place before it takes its first customer: structuring input, registrations, elections, and how its products and pricing are taxed. You'll work with the founder in residence, Valsoft's finance and legal teams, and the VP, Tax on structuring decisions.
 A venture that starts with the wrong registrations or an untested sales tax position carries that into every invoice. You'll make those calls early, document the positions you take, and build a setup checklist so each new venture starts faster than the last.
 Run compliance across the ventures 
 You'll manage Canadian federal and provincial corporate income tax returns and U.S. federal and state income and franchise tax returns for each venture, reviewing what external providers prepare. You'll keep a tax calendar, records, and audit files for every company, and resolve notices and correspondence from the CRA, Revenu Québec, the IRS, and state authorities.
 As ventures enter other markets, you'll coordinate corporate and indirect tax filings with local advisors and decide when a venture needs its own registrations there.
 Own sales and indirect tax 
 You'll own U.S. sales and use tax for the ventures: nexus monitoring, registrations, taxability analysis, filing, and remittance. In Canada you'll manage GST/HST and QST, including registrations, returns, and input tax credit and input tax refund recovery.
 You'll work with each venture's finance and billing setup so customer invoices charge the right tax in each jurisdiction, and keep exemption certificates and supporting documentation ready for audit. Early customers often come through Valsoft's portfolio businesses, so a wrong tax charge lands on a relationship the venture depends on.
 Handle intercompany and group reporting 
 Ventures run on Valsoft's capital, infrastructure, and support, which means intercompany arrangements from the first day. You'll set up and document those arrangements, coordinate transfer pricing documentation with external advisors in line with CRA, IRS, and OECD guidelines, and support any inquiries.
 You'll prepare tax provisions under IFRS, including current and deferred tax and uncertain tax positions, and give Valsoft's corporate tax team its group inputs: T106 and T1134 foreign reporting, associated corporation schedules, country-by-country reporting, and Pillar Two data.
 Build the tax process Ventures runs on 
 You'll design the processes, controls, and tools that let tax keep up as the number of ventures grows, and decide where a tax engine or automation is worth adding. Founders, finance, and legal will treat you as their main contact on tax, and you'll explain requirements in plain terms.
 You'll give tax input on new products, pricing models, market entry, and partnership arrangements, summarize legislative changes that affect the ventures, and support the VP, Tax on structuring as a venture grows into an independent business.
 What you'll bring
 A CPA designation (Canada or U.S.).
 At least 4 years of post-designation tax experience in public accounting or a corporate tax environment, with exposure to both Canadian and U.S. tax.
 Working knowledge of transfer pricing, international tax, and tax accounting under IFRS.
 You can look at a new business model and work out what tax it triggers before it launches.
 You prepare, review, and file returns yourself.
 You manage external advisors and hold them to deadlines and quality.
 You can give a founder a clear tax answer they can act on the same day.
 You use AI to research, draft, and analyze, and you check the output before it goes anywhere.
 You work independently and keep several companies' calendars moving at once.
 You finish what you start and keep records an auditor can follow.
 Useful experience
 Hands-on U.S. sales and use tax compliance
 Canadian GST/HST and QST compliance
 Tax for startups or newly formed entities
 Sales tax treatment of software and SaaS
 Voluntary disclosures
 Working in a group with many subsidiaries
 Bilingual
 Who will enjoy this role
 You like getting something right before it becomes a problem. A founder mentions a new pricing model on Monday, and by Wednesday you've worked out where it creates nexus and what the invoice needs to say.
 In one week you might register a new entity, review a U.S. state return for an older venture, and walk a founder in residence through what QST means for their first Quebec customer.
 The hard part is that every venture is different and none of them waits for tax. Founders move fast, priorities shift when a venture changes direction, and you'll often set up a company whose product isn't finished yet.

 L'IA devrait faire partie de votre façon de travailler. Servez-vous-en pour faire de la recherche, rédiger, analyser et automatiser. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du résultat.
 Ce qui compte pour nous
 Un bon jugement et le souci du détail.
 Prendre ses responsabilités et terminer le travail sans qu'on ait à relancer.
 Comprendre comment une jeune entreprise gagne de l'argent et comment la fiscalité en découle.
 La curiosité et la volonté de changer une approche qui ne fonctionne pas.
 L'honnêteté de dire quand une position n'est pas défendable, y compris la vôtre.
 Ce que vous ferez
 Mettre chaque nouvelle entreprise sur pied correctement 
 Quand Ventures décide de bâtir une entreprise, vous déterminez ce qui doit être en place sur le plan fiscal avant qu'elle serve son premier client : conseils sur la structure, inscriptions, choix fiscaux et traitement fiscal de ses produits et de sa tarification. Vous travaillerez avec le fondateur en résidence, les équipes Finances et Affaires juridiques de Valsoft, et le vice-président, Fiscalité sur les décisions de structure.
 Une entreprise qui démarre avec les mauvaises inscriptions ou une position non validée en matière de taxes de vente reporte l'erreur sur chaque facture. Vous prendrez ces décisions tôt, documenterez les positions retenues et bâtirez une liste de contrôle de démarrage pour que chaque nouvelle entreprise parte plus vite que la précédente.
 Assurer la conformité de toutes les entreprises 
 Vous gérerez les déclarations de revenus fédérales et provinciales des sociétés au Canada, ainsi que les déclarations fédérales et d'États (impôt sur le revenu et franchise tax) aux États-Unis, pour chaque entreprise, en révisant ce que préparent les fournisseurs externes. Vous tiendrez un calendrier fiscal, des registres et des dossiers de vérification pour chaque société, et réglerez les avis et la correspondance de l'ARC, de Revenu Québec, de l'IRS et des autorités des États.

Au Canada, vous gérerez la TPS/TVH et la TVQ, y compris les inscriptions, les déclarations ainsi que la récupération des crédits de taxe sur les intrants (CTI) et des remboursements de la taxe sur les intrants (RTI).
 Vous travaillerez avec les responsables des finances et de la facturation de chaque entreprise pour que les factures aux clients appliquent la bonne taxe dans chaque territoire, et tiendrez les certificats d'exemption et les pièces justificatives prêts pour une vérification.  Gérer l'intersociétés et la déclaration au niveau du groupe

Vous mettrez en place et documenterez ces ententes, coordonnerez avec des conseillers externes la documentation sur les prix de transfert conformément aux lignes directrices de l'ARC, de l'IRS et de l'OCDE, et soutiendrez l'entreprise lors des demandes de renseignements.
 Vous préparerez les provisions d'impôt selon les IFRS, y compris l'impôt exigible et différé et les positions fiscales incertaines, et fournirez à l'équipe de fiscalité corporative de Valsoft les données dont elle a besoin pour le groupe : déclarations de renseignements étrangers T106 et T1134, annexes sur les sociétés associées, déclaration pays par pays et données du Pilier Deux.
 Bâtir le processus fiscal de Ventures

Les fondateurs, les équipes Finances et Affaires juridiques vous considéreront comme leur principale personne-ressource en fiscalité, et vous leur expliquerez les exigences en termes simples.
 Vous donnerez votre avis fiscal sur les nouveaux produits, les modèles de tarification, l'entrée dans de nouveaux marchés et les partenariats, résumerez les changements législatifs qui touchent les entreprises, et appuierez le vice-président, Fiscalité sur la structure lorsqu'une entreprise devient une société indépendante.
 Ce que vous apportez
 Le titre de CPA (Canada ou États-Unis).
 Au moins 4 ans d'expérience en fiscalité après l'obtention du titre, en cabinet comptable ou en entreprise, touchant à la fois la fiscalité canadienne et américaine.
 Une connaissance pratique des prix de transfert, de la fiscalité internationale et de la comptabilisation des impôts selon les IFRS.
 Vous savez examiner un nouveau modèle d'affaires et déterminer ses conséquences fiscales avant son lancement.
 Vous préparez, révisez et produisez vous-même les déclarations.
 Vous gérez des conseillers externes et les tenez responsables des échéances et de la qualité.
 Vous savez donner à un fondateur une réponse fiscale claire sur laquelle il peut agir le jour même.
 Vous utilisez l'IA pour faire de la recherche, rédiger et analyser, et vous vérifiez le résultat avant qu'il aille plus loin.
 Vous travaillez de façon autonome et faites avancer les calendriers de plusieurs sociétés à la fois.
 Vous terminez ce que vous commencez et tenez des dossiers qu'un vérificateur peut suivre.
 Expérience utile
 Conformité pratique en sales and use tax américaine
 Conformité en TPS/TVH et TVQ
 Fiscalité de jeunes entreprises ou de sociétés nouvellement constituées
 Traitement des logiciels et du SaaS en matière de taxes de vente
 Divulgations volontaires
 Travail au sein d'un groupe comptant de nombreuses filiales
 Bilingue
 Qui aimera ce poste
 Vous aimez régler les choses avant qu'elles deviennent des problèmes. Un fondateur mentionne un nouveau modèle de tarification le lundi, et le mercredi, vous savez déjà où il crée un lien fiscal et ce que la facture doit indiquer.
 Dans une même semaine, vous pourriez inscrire une nouvelle entité, réviser une déclaration d'État américaine pour une entreprise plus établie et expliquer à un fondateur en résidence ce que la TVQ implique pour son premier client au Québec.
 Le plus difficile, c'est que chaque entreprise est différente et qu'aucune n'attend la fiscalité. Les fondateurs avancent vite, les priorités changent quand une entreprise change de cap, et vous mettrez souvent sur pied une société dont le produit n'est pas encore terminé.

 The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call . As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 
 This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday .  Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.
 Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.
 Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.

Reporting to the Director of Indigenous Enagagement  the Indigenous Cultural and Events Coordinator, will be based in Johnson Cobbe on the 4th floor with the Office of Indigenous Engagement team, located on SAIT’s main campus.
The Indigenous Cultural and Events Coordinator plays a key support role in ensuring culturally respectful, inclusive, and diverse programming is available to Indigenous students and the SAIT community. Grounded in principles of respect, relationship, and reciprocity, this role works closely with Natoysopoyiis, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and Cultural Advisors from Treaty 7 Nations and the Métis Nation to facilitate cultural and spiritual programming, events, and ceremonies that support students’ cultural connection, wellness, and community building. The Indigenous Cultural and Events Coordinator will also work in collaboration with Corporate Services, Communications, Marketing and various other internal and external people.
It is important to note that this position does not lead or deliver ceremonies. Those responsibilities remain with the Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and Cultural Advisors who have been entrusted with these teachings through years of mentorship and recognition within their communities. The coordinator ensures that these respected individuals are supported, that proper protocols are upheld, and that students have access to diverse Indigenous knowledge, languages, and practices in a safe, welcoming, and respectful environment.

The Role: Support the coordination and logistics of cultural and spiritual programming within Natoysopoyiis and SAIT, including ceremonies, knowledge-sharing sessions, traditional arts and crafts, language sessions, and other culturally significant events (Indigenous Graduation Celebration and Annual Pow Wow).
 Engage and collaborate with a diverse range of Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and Cultural Advisors to ensure programming reflects the diverse teachings, languages, and traditions of the Treaty 7 Nations and Métis Nation.
 Organize and promote Indigenous cultural sessions for students and SAIT that enhances access to cultural supports, teachings, and community connection.
 Provide support to students seeking access to cultural and spiritual supports by ensuring they are connected with the appropriate Elders, Knowledge Keepers, or cultural facilitators, and by ensuring a welcoming, safe, and culturally grounded environment.
 Ensure that all events and programming adhere to cultural protocols, respect the teachings shared, and provide a safe and welcoming space for Indigenous students and SAIT community members.
 Collaborate with SAIT departments, Student Services, and external Indigenous community organizations to support integrated, culturally appropriate programming and ensure seamless connections for students seeking support.
 The coordinator will play an important role in fostering an environment where Indigenous students and SAIT community can engage with their culture, languages, and traditions in meaningful and respectful ways. By supporting Elders and Knowledge Keepers to share their teachings, this position contributes to the broader goal of increasing cultural awareness, understanding, and reconciliation within the SAIT community.
Qualifications: Degree /Diploma in social sciences, education, social work, humanities, or a related field, with a minimum of three years’ experience working with Indigenous peoples, ideally in an educational setting. A bachelor’s degree is preferred.
 Strong understanding of, and positive relationship with, Indigenous cultures, communities, and histories, particularly those of Treaty 7 Nations and the Métis Nation.
 Knowledge of the unique needs and experiences of Indigenous students in post-secondary environments.
 Demonstrated ability to build respectful relationships with Indigenous students, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and community members.
 Strong communication, organization, and time management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities.
 Strong public speaking and presentation skills, with cultural humility and respect.
 Experience working in an Indigenous organization or community-driven environment is considered an asset.

 SAIT Policy and Procedure AC 2.15 .1 Indigenous Student Success Guide

 SAIT policies and procedures

 Coordinate logistics for cultural and spiritual programming at SAIT including booking spaces, arranging supplies, and providing event support.

 Support the planning and coordination of traditional ceremonies, Indigenous Graduation Celebration, Pow Wow, language and sharing sessions in collaboration with Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and Cultural Advisors.

 Relationship Building and Community Engagement

 Build and maintain strong relationships with Indigenous communities, organizations, and cultural practitioners.

 Build and maintain relationships with internal partners including Corporate Services, Communications, Marketing and various other internal departments at SAIT.
 Protocol and Cultural Safety Stewardship 
 Ensure all cultural and spiritual programming follows appropriate Indigenous protocols and cultural practices.
 Support the respectful use and care of sacred spaces, ceremonial items, and cultural tools within Natoysopoyiis and SAIT events.
 Educate and guide students and staff on appropriate cultural protocols, in consultation with Elders and Knowledge Keepers.
 Program Coordination and Administration
 Coordinate schedules, bookings, and logistics to support Indigenous students' access to cultural and spiritual programming, ensuring events are welcoming, student-centered, and culturally safe.
 Promote programming and events using culturally appropriate, student-focused communication methods, ensuring Indigenous students are aware of and feel invited to participate in all offerings.
 Monitor student participation and gather feedback from students, Elders, and Knowledge Keepers to ensure programming continues to meet the needs, interests, and cultural expectations of Indigenous students.
 Work alongside Natoysopoyiis team members and Student Services to create meaningful opportunities for cultural connection, ensuring that programming reflects the diverse teachings and practices important to Indigenous students.

 Serve as a key contributor to institutional committees and working groups supporting Indigenous events and initiatives, including but not limited to:
 Indigenous Student Orientation
 Indigenous Graduation Celebration
 Annual Powwow
 SAIT Truth and Reconciliation Event Series
 Indigenous Engagement Advisory Council
 Provide guidance and support to these events by connecting Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and cultural facilitators, ensuring cultural protocols are honored and respected.
 Support SAIT’s broader commitments to Truth and Reconciliation by offering culturally grounded input into institutional events, awareness campaigns, and programming initiatives.
 Administration 
 Respond to inquiries from students regarding cultural programming and events.
 Track participation and engagement in cultural and spiritual programming and support the collection of feedback to assess program effectiveness and inform future planning.
 Collaborate with other team members in Natoysopoyiis to support broader initiatives related to Indigenous student recruitment, retention, and success.
 Assist with day-to-day administrative tasks to ensure the smooth operation of cultural programming and Indigenous student supports.

 This role requires a deep understanding of, and commitment to, Indigenous cultural safety, community protocols, and the diverse teachings and practices across Treaty 7 Nations and the Métis Nation.
 The coordinator will recognize and honor that Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and Cultural Advisors are the rightful holders and sharers of Indigenous knowledge and will not take on the role of a ceremonial leader.

Cette personne est imputable du cadre de gouvernance et de l’architecture de référence de l’IA à l’échelle de l’entreprise.  Définir et faire évoluer les cadres de gouvernance de l’IA : rôles, responsabilités, processus décisionnels, politiques, standards et garde-fous encadrant l’IA générative et les agent·e·s intelligents afin d’éclairer la haute direction quant aux risques et aux opportunités.

 Définir les contrôles de gestion des identités, de protection des données, de journalisation, de traçabilité et d’observabilité des agent·e·s intelligents.
 Évaluer les risques liés aux fournisseurs d’IA (souveraineté des données, dépendance technologique, concentration des services) et participer à leur sélection et à leur homologation.

 Contribuer à la surveillance des modèles et des agent·e·s ainsi qu’à la gestion des incidents impliquant l’IA, en collaboration avec les équipes de sécurité et d’opérations.
 Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires et technologiques dans l’adoption responsable de l’IA, agir à titre d’expert·e-conseil auprès de la haute direction et représenter l’organisation auprès des instances de gouvernance, des partenaires, des organismes de réglementation et des fournisseurs d’IA.
 Assurer une veille stratégique des tendances, normes, pratiques émergentes et cadres réglementaires liés à l’intelligence artificielle afin de recommander les ajustements requis aux orientations de l’organisation.
